g.title: K01 · Seller-to-shop key lookup; unmatched ids remain flagged by seller_found.
K02 · Shop master match; non-master contract shop ids are retained and flagged.
K03 · Shop lookup on leads; use shop_in_master to scope analysis.
K04 · Assignment history by shop; no Employee dimension exists.
K05 · A contract can have multiple goods rows; aggregate before joining case-level measures.
K06 · One-row-per-case goods summary; line 1 chosen by the smallest line_no.
K07 · clean_lead.finish_code is mapped from result_code; code_lead_status is not the outcome.
K08 · Sparse direct contract id on converted leads; not the general attribution rule.
T01 · Assignment time is allocated to shop-months; dup_rank > 1 is retained but excluded from FTE.
L01 · Candidate rule: same client, same product, date_assigned ≤ dt_apply; choose the latest eligible lead.
L02 · Ties use the largest lead_row. This is the team’s deterministic tie-break, not an FK constraint.
T02a · Shop-id union source; in_master distinguishes ids present in the master.
T02b · Adds every shop id observed in contracts and contract activity totals.
T02c · Adds every non-null shop id observed in leads and weighted lead totals.
T03a · Builds the master-shop monthly grid.
T03b · Contract measures grouped by shop and application month.
T03c · Lead counts use sample weight and lead-assigned month.
T04 · Cross-sell measures use master-shop scope and a 90-day lead-to-apply window.
T05 · Adds staffing measures at shop-month grain.
Q01 · 29 checks: 24 PASS, 5 INFO, 0 FAIL. This is QA lineage, not a foreign key.
